2609.34973.title: APEX-Voice: Can Voice Agents Complete Professional Workflows Through Full-Duplex Interaction
2609.34973.paper_summary: Full-duplex voice agents can now listen, speak, use tools, and act during spoken interactions, but fluent dialogue does not guarantee correct completion of delegated professional workflows. We introduce APEX-Voice, a benchmark of 120 interactive professional workflows spanning ten work archetypes such as form completion, corporate negotiation, coordination, consulting, and interviewing. Each workflow executes in a stateful Voice Workbench environment with task-specific knowledge, typed tools, gold-annotated final work artifact, authorization constraints, and a user simulation policy backed by validated, pre-compiled speech realizations. We evaluate both artifact field accuracy and end-to-end workflow success, which requires the correct terminal state, valid process, completed actions, and a valid final artifact. Across five frontier real-time voice agents-GPT-Live-1, Gemini-3.8-Live, Grok-Voice-Think-2.0, Step-Audio3, and GPT-realtime-2.1, none exceeds 25% Pass@1, and the best Reliable@3 is only 10.8%. Moreover, stateful coordination is the dominant failure point across systems, while success decreases further on workflows requiring greater knowledge retrieval and mid-speech corrections. Overall, APEX-Voice is the first benchmark for evaluating whether voice agents can translate conversational competence into dependable professional work.
2609.34973.paper_summary_zh: 全雙工語音代理現在可以在口語互動中聆聽、說話、使用工具和行動，但流利的對話並不保證能正確完成委派的專業工作流程。我們介紹APEX-Voice，這是一個涵蓋十種工作原型的120個互動專業工作流程的基準，例如表單填寫、企業談判、協調、諮詢和面試。每個工作流程都在具有任務特定知識的有狀態語音工作台環境中執行，配備了類型化工具、金標註的最終工作產物、授權約束，以及由經過驗證的預編譯語音實現支持的用戶模擬政策。我們評估了產物現場準確性和端到端工作流程成功率，這需要正確的終端狀態、有效的過程、完成的行動和有效的最終產物。在五個前沿實時語音代理中——GPT-Live-1、Gemini-3.8-Live、Grok-Voice-Think-2.0、Step-Audio3和GPT-realtime-2.1，沒有一個超過25%的Pass@1，而最佳的Reliable@3僅為10.8%。此外，有狀態的協調是系統中主要的失敗點，而在需要更大知識檢索和中途修正的工作流程中，成功率進一步下降。總的來說，APEX-Voice是評估語音代理是否能將對話能力轉化為可靠專業工作的首個基準。
2609.34973.author: Puneet Mathur et.al.
